high_level_description: The image shows a close-up view of the Martian surface captured by NASA's Mars rover. The terrain is rugged and rocky, with a reddish-brown hue characteristic of the planet's soil. The image prominently features three labeled areas marked as "BOXWORK RIDGE," indicating specific geological formations. The text overlay on the image reads: "NASA’s Mars rover captures first close-up of bizarre 'spiderwebs' on the Red Planet." This suggests that the image is part of a news article from the Times of India, dated 3 days ago.
